Speach personalities:
Opal: Trying to express confidense and being sofficisticated, deeply insecure and uncertain. Strong willed and wants to help but not sure if she can. Trying to lead and show how she is able to keep things safe and create lasting thigns but insecure due to a hidden secret. All of this is super subtle, but dialogue should hint at it.
Tyson: Very shy and tries not to talk to others outside of opal due to being bullied by alexis. To opal he is confident and ignorant at the same time. Screams lack of self awareness. Especially with respect to his narasism and savior complex all the while never willing to make any real sacrifies and demanding others sacrife everything to help him. At his best they are wise, kind, and non-judgemental. At his worst, bitter, resentful, and fatalistic
Victor: Go with the flow, talks a lot and wastes your time especially on talking about art. He knows a lot about it and always tries to bring it up. Doesn't care that he is bad at it especially clouds. But deep down he is uneasy about something that he doesn't want to tell anyone about. Others can sorta tell he's hiding something which he tries to avoid talking about and refuses to elorate on. Very non commital journey over the desination and lax type. At his best, the he is empathetic and relentless problem-solver. At his worst he is ruthless, defensive, and impulsive.
Alexis: Super aggressive in her speach. Tries to argue about everything so that she can win. Leaves everyone around her exhuasted to the degree they just say shes rigth and move on even if they don't intend on actually doing what she wants others to do. She is a bully. Super mad too that no one listens to her or does what she tells them. Very angry/unhappy because of it along with no one being able to get things done. Especially with Opal, victor, and tyson. Now also even more so with Austine as he told victor he can't use his new powers, and opal can't help her as she needs to help elsewhere. She is a bringers of confusion and doubt, and she can be frustratingly difficult to convince otherwise when she has attached themselves to an idea. If she sounds dangerous, she is. She tend to be most volatile and unpredictable of the group. At her best she are original, revolutionary, and fearless. At her worst she is cruel, uncompromising, and vicious. 
Austine: Tries to be very logical in everything. Bit of a snob and know it all. Good at guessing what people will say next. Very detached and doesn't have a lot of care for those around him. Everything is just academic for him. Others come to him for what he would do but he very much is the type more to show than to tell, and insists others figure their own stuff out. Its easy for him to see the multitudes of the choices laid out before him, which often leaves him frozen and unable to act. That said, when a he finally launches into action, they can execute a plan with unbelievable grace and precision. His identity is fluid-it can change from day-to-day, from thought-to-thought, from interaction-to-interaction. Remaining logical is more important to him than building up a solid foundation of "self." At their best he is a great innovators, architects, and creators. At his worst he can be nasty, inflexible, and indecisive
Chloe: Quite around those who are chatty but chatty aroudn those who are quiet. Tries to get others who are having a bad time to have a postive outlook, but tries to temper those who are happy go lucky with some realism. They also have the tendency to put other's needs before her own, which never ends well for anyone, because the they are a bit bitter as she feels her own self-care has had to be shunted aside. At her best, they are great listeners, caretakers, and nurturers. At her worst, the Chloe are passive aggressive, and pushy-they're certain they know best.
Isabela: Everyone even Alexis are on good terms with her, and she is the central nexis for talkign to people without drama happening. Very no nonsense too and says it how she sees it only person that can basically tell Alexis to cool down, but she doesn't do it a lot out of fear it'll hurt their friendship. Talks a lot, but very intentionally to get everyone to work together. She can dispense excellent advice even when their own outlook is look so great. She can be very "do as I say, not as I do" types. She can often be found on a sinking ship, forcing an endeavor forward with sheer stubborn force of will. No matter how bad things go, a she can always count on friends and allies. At their best, she is charismatic, uplifting, and magnetic. At her worst she can be sullen, unkind, and set-in-their-ways
Nicholas: Total sociopath, very intelegent, but also cryptic and he doesn't ever try to help others figure things out and will go out of his way to try and lead them in the wrong direction so he can get a leg up. Total two face as well. Not at all a team player but very useful and does get things done although he has terrible luck and attributes everything to his own skill. He is quiet but has a big presense, but never tries to take center stage. They often take rules as simple suggestions, instead searching for loopholes or work-arounds. At his best, the he is resourceful and driven. At his worst he can be fussy, pedantic, and insensitive

Verbal Ticks and Speech Styles:

Opal: Uses formal, sophisticated language. Hedges statements with "I believe", "perhaps", "it seems". Overcompensates with declarative confidence but undermines it with subtle qualifiers. Speaks in measured tones but occasionally reveals uncertainty.

Tyson: Short, minimal responses to most people due to shyness. Becomes verbose and self-centered with Opal. Uses "I" statements frequently when comfortable. Phrases requests as expectations rather than asks.

Victor: Rambles and goes off on tangents, especially about art. Uses non-committal phrases like "maybe", "whatever", "doesn't really matter". Deflects with "anyway" or subject changes when uncomfortable. References clouds and artistic techniques unprompted.

Alexis: Aggressive, confrontational language. Uses imperatives and demands. Short, sharp sentences. Frequent "WHY" questions and challenges. Interrupts and dismisses. Uses "You need to", "You have to", "Obviously".

Austine: Formal, academic language with condescending undertones. Uses logical connectors: "therefore", "consequently", "logically speaking". Rhetorical questions to make points. Detached observations rather than emotional statements.

Chloe: Mirrors conversational partner's energy level. Uses balancing statements with "but", "however", "on the other hand". Can be passive-aggressive when frustrated. Nurturing language with an edge of bitterness about self-sacrifice.

Isabela: Direct, no-nonsense communication. Cuts to the point. Uses practical, motivational language. Team-focused with "we", "together", "all of us". Gives advice freely but admits when struggling herself.

Nicholas: Cryptic and vague responses. Speaks in riddles or double meanings. Minimal, terse answers. Uses misdirection and implication rather than direct statements. Questions often answer questions.
